# UI & CSS Architect Skill Instructions

When building, styling, or refactoring web user interfaces, strictly enforce these design standards:

## 1. Aesthetic Excellence
- Use vibrant, harmonized color palettes (HSL/RGB variables with CSS tokens) instead of browser default colors.
- Incorporate glassmorphism, subtle drop shadows, smooth gradients, and cohesive border radiuses.
- Use Google Fonts or modern system fonts (Inter, Outfit, Roboto) for clean hierarchy and typography.

## 2. Interactive & Responsive Design
- Add responsive layout rules (`flex`, `grid`, container queries, media breakpoints) for mobile and desktop screens.
- Include smooth micro-animations, hover effects (`transition: all 0.2s ease`), active states, and focus indicators.
- Avoid hardcoded static pixel offsets where dynamic dynamic bounding measurements are appropriate.

## 3. Design System & CSS Tokens
- Define CSS custom properties (`--color-primary`, `--bg-glass`, `--radius-md`) for consistent token usage across components.
- Keep component styles organized and scoped, respecting design boundaries.
- Ensure proper color contrast for web accessibility compliance (WCAG standards).
